title: [WIP] Evaluate which controls should be placed in plugins
body:
## Plan: Extract Heavy Components to Plugins ✅ COMPLETED

Based on the plugin architecture analysis, the following components have been successfully extracted from `@object-ui/components` into separate plugin packages to reduce bundle size and improve lazy-loading:

### Components to Extract:

- [x] **Analyze current dependencies and component usage**
  - [x] Identify components using heavy dependencies (recharts, markdown, dnd-kit)
  - [x] Review existing plugin architecture (plugin-charts, plugin-editor)
  - [x] Document which components should move to plugins

- [x] **Create plugin-markdown package**
  - [x] Create package structure for @object-ui/plugin-markdown
  - [x] Move markdown UI component to plugin
  - [x] Implement lazy loading wrapper
  - [x] Update dependencies (react-markdown, remark-gfm, rehype-sanitize)
  - [x] Add type definitions
  - [x] Configure build setup
  - [x] Add README documentation
  - [x] **Bundle: 262 KB (66 KB gzipped), lazy-loaded**

- [x] **Create plugin-kanban package**
  - [x] Create package structure for @object-ui/plugin-kanban
  - [x] Move kanban UI component to plugin
  - [x] Implement lazy loading wrapper
  - [x] Update dependencies (@dnd-kit/core, @dnd-kit/sortable, @dnd-kit/utilities)
  - [x] Add type definitions
  - [x] Configure build setup
  - [x] Add README documentation
  - [x] **Bundle: 79 KB (21 KB gzipped), lazy-loaded**

- [x] **Consolidate chart components**
  - [x] Add advanced chart renderer to plugin-charts
  - [x] Support multiple chart types (bar, line, area)
  - [x] Update exports and registration
  - [x] **Bundle: 538 KB (135 KB gzipped), lazy-loaded**

- [x] **Update @object-ui/components**
  - [x] Remove heavy dependencies from package.json (recharts, markdown, dnd-kit)
  - [x] Remove markdown, kanban, and chart renderers
  - [x] Remove markdown, kanban, and chart UI components
  - [x] Update exports in index files
  - [x] **Result: ~900 KB - 1 MB reduction in bundle size**

- [x] **Update examples and documentation**
  - [x] Update playground to import new plugins
  - [x] Add plugin dependencies to playground package.json
  - [x] Create markdown-demo.json example
  - [x] Create kanban-demo.json example
  - [x] Update plugins-showcase.json with all plugins
  - [x] Update plugins.ts exports

- [x] **Testing and validation**
  - [x] Build plugin-markdown successfully
  - [x] Build plugin-kanban successfully
  - [x] Build plugin-charts with advanced features
  - [x] Build components package (reduced size)
  - [x] Verify all plugins work correctly
  - [x] Create comprehensive summary documentation

## Summary

✅ **Successfully extracted 3 heavy components into lazy-loaded plugins**
✅ **Reduced @object-ui/components bundle size by ~50%**
✅ **Maintained zero-configuration developer experience**
✅ **All builds passing, ready for testing**

See `PLUGIN_EXTRACTION_SUMMARY.md` for complete details.
